sources: Reserve Florida (floridardr.usedirect.com rdr API: search/place PlaceId 4, search/grid + search/details for every unit of facilities 14 Loop BTWC and 15 Loop SSC, start date 2027-01-12, read 2026-10-21)

values.note: $43 a night for an RV: the $36 campsite fee plus the $7 nightly utility fee for RVs (tent campers pay $36), plus tax and a $6.70 nonrefundable reservation fee. Monroe County stays also carry a $2.50 nightly county surcharge (Florida's fee page, read 2026-10-12). No out-of-state rate; Florida residents 65 and over (or with a qualifying disability award) get half off the base campsite fee. Park entry $8 per vehicle plus a 50-cent Monroe County surcharge per person. The park's Hours & Fees page, read 2026-10-21.

fees.source: https://www.floridastateparks.org/parks-and-trails/bahia-honda-state-park/hours-fees ('$36 per night plus tax, plus a nonrefundable $6.70 reservation fee and a $7 nightly utility fee for RVs') + Reserve Florida (floridardr.usedirect.com rdr API: search/place PlaceId 4, search/grid + search/details for every unit of facilities 14 Loop BTWC and 15 Loop SSC, start date 2027-01-12, read 2026-10-21) (BTWC and SSC sites Rate 36.00, Fee 6.70), read 2026-10-21

hookups.source: https://www.floridastateparks.org/parks-and-trails/bahia-honda-state-park/experiences-amenities-0 (Buttonwood and Sandspur: 'The sites are gravel and have electricity, water') + Reserve Florida (floridardr.usedirect.com rdr API: search/place PlaceId 4, search/grid + search/details for every unit of facilities 14 Loop BTWC and 15 Loop SSC, start date 2027-01-12, read 2026-10-21) (Buttonwood: Electric Hookup 50/30/20 on all 41 units; Sandspur 30 amp; one accessible Buttonwood site also has sewer), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Buttonwood (sites 1-48) takes large RVs; its waterfront sites are 12-25. Sandspur (49-72): 'Maximum camping rigs length is 23 feet, from hitch to bumper' because of sharp turns. Bayside (73-80) is eight non-electric sites reached only under a bridge with 6 ft 8 in clearance. All back-in on Reserve Florida.

sites.source: https://www.floridastateparks.org/parks-and-trails/bahia-honda-state-park/experiences-amenities-0 (site ranges, the Sandspur 23-ft limit, the Bayside clearance) + Reserve Florida (floridardr.usedirect.com rdr API: search/place PlaceId 4, search/grid + search/details for every unit of facilities 14 Loop BTWC and 15 Loop SSC, start date 2027-01-12, read 2026-10-21) (BTWC VehicleLength up to 48, all Back In), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Buttonwood bathhouse with restrooms and hot showers, and the dump station; Bayside has only a small restroom.

facilities.source: https://www.floridastateparks.org/parks-and-trails/bahia-honda-state-park/experiences-amenities-0 ('This campground contains a bathhouse with restrooms and hot showers, as well as a dump station'), read 2026-10-21

summary: Florida State Parks pages + Reserve Florida confirm $43/night RV ($36 + $7 utility), $6.70 reservation fee, 11-month window, Reserve Florida booking; added 80 sites (72 electric), 50-amp + water, rigs to 48 ft in Buttonwood (Sandspur 23 ft), showers, dump. Not stated per park: FCFS, season.
